raw_clock_report.scope: Actual resistor-component membership, native saved voltage edge brackets and incident wire capacitance. Nearest same-polarity edge association is diagnostic only; it does not alter or qualify original bit-phase gates. R graph excludes intrinsic device paths. RF/substrate and analog device capacitances are not included in reported wire C.

report.meaning: Envelope includes every paired native edge bracket; nearest same-polarity association is diagnostic, not acceptance or proof of causal delay. Missing edges remain explicit. Wire C excludes intrinsic/RF/body models.
